_README: Elevations for cities GeoNames has no reading for. Its dem column stores
-9999 where the 90m SRTM tile is unusable — coastal points and small
islands, mostly — and scripts/build-cities.mjs drops that rather than
letting it pass as a real figure. A pool needs the elevation on every one
of its cities before the altitude cards are offered at all, so one gap
costs the whole set its highest/lowest pair. These fill the gaps.
Keyed by geonameid. Applied by build-sets.mjs and build-daily.mjs, both
of which warn about an entry that is never used, so the file cannot
quietly rot as sets change or a later gazetteer build supplies the
reading itself. Figures are approximate published city-centre values, in
metres, in the same spirit as the hand-written sets they replaced.
